hc.comp.infoAbs: Each bar is the weight, split into skeletal muscle, other lean mass (weight − muscle − fat) and body fat. The number on top is the weight in {u}.

hc.seg.title: Body parts
hc.seg.sides: Right: ▶ triangle pointing right. Left: ◀ triangle pointing left. Both sides are solid lines in the same colour.
hc.seg.infoKg: Lean mass (top, blue) and body fat (bottom, orange) of the chosen body part, in {u}. Each has its own scale because there is several times less fat.
hc.seg.infoPct: Lean mass (top) and body fat (bottom) as the % of ideal printed on InBody result sheets. Measurements whose source doesn't print it are left out, not estimated.
hc.seg.infoBal: Right minus left, for lean mass (top) and body fat (bottom), in {u}. Zero means both sides are equal.
hc.seg.infoPctw: Lean mass (top) and body fat (bottom) of the chosen body part as % of body weight. It is computed for each measurement from that day's weight, unlike % of ideal, which InBody prints.

privacy.where.title: Where it lives and who can see it
privacy.where.1: Uploaded files and measurement results are stored in Microsoft Azure, in the Frankfurt data centre (region Germany West Central).
privacy.where.2: Only Vojta, as the administrator, and the people you choose to share your history with can access them. They get read-only access, and you can stop sharing at any time.
privacy.where.3: Photos and PDFs of results are sent to Anthropic's Claude API (USA) to be read. Anthropic does not use API data to train its models and deletes it after 30 days. A CSV export is not sent anywhere; it is processed right here.
privacy.where.4: We never store the name or ID printed on the result sheet.
privacy.where.5: Deleting in the app only hides your data; it is not erased.
privacy.protect.title: How we protect it
privacy.protect.1: The connection is always encrypted (HTTPS), and data in Azure is also encrypted at rest.
privacy.protect.2: Only Vojta creates accounts; there is no sign-up. Passwords are stored only as a hash, never readable.
privacy.protect.3: Login allows only a few attempts, and repeated failures lock the account temporarily.
privacy.protect.4: Every request checks that the data is yours or shared with you. Guessing a link will not get you someone else's data: IDs cannot be guessed, and the answer is the same whether a record does not exist or you have no access to it.
privacy.protect.5: Files have no public link; they can only be opened through the app while logged in.
privacy.protect.6: The app signs in to the database and storage with an Azure identity: no passwords, no access keys in the code.
privacy.protect.7: Notifications to Vojta never contain measured values.

rep.info.label: About this section
def.weight_kg: Your total body weight, measured by the scale built into the InBody device.
def.skeletal_muscle_mass_kg: The mass of the muscles attached to your bones, the ones you move and train. InBody estimates it from bioimpedance (how a weak current passes through the body).
def.body_fat_mass_kg: The total mass of fat in your body; InBody estimates it from bioimpedance as weight minus fat-free mass.
def.bmi: Weight divided by height squared (kg/m²); it doesn't tell muscle from fat.
def.percent_body_fat: The share of fat in your body weight, in %.
def.visceral_fat_level: InBody's estimate of the fat stored around the internal organs in the belly, as a level from 1 to 20.
def.waist_hip_ratio: Waist circumference divided by hip circumference, as InBody estimates them.
def.obesity_degree_pct: Your weight as a % of the standard weight for your height, as InBody calculates it; 100 % means exactly the standard.
def.total_body_water_l: All the water in your body, inside and outside the cells; InBody estimates it from bioimpedance.
def.protein_kg: The mass of protein in the body, mostly in muscle; an InBody estimate.
def.minerals_kg: The mass of minerals, mostly in the bones; an InBody estimate.
def.fat_free_mass_kg: Everything that isn't fat: muscle, water, organs and bones; weight minus body fat.
def.dry_lean_mass_kg: Fat-free mass without the water (protein plus minerals).
def.soft_lean_mass_kg: Fat-free mass without the bone minerals.
def.bmr_kcal: The energy your body uses in a day at complete rest; InBody calculates it from fat-free mass.
def.inbody_score: InBody's own overall rating of your body composition, in points; it rises with muscle and falls with excess fat.
def.smi_kg_m2: The lean mass of your arms and legs divided by height squared (kg/m²).
def.recommended_intake_kcal: InBody's estimate of the daily energy intake for your body composition (kcal per day).
def.seg_lean: Muscle, water and other non-fat tissue in that arm, leg or the trunk; not the same as skeletal muscle (SMM). InBody estimates it per segment from bioimpedance.
def.seg_fat: The fat in that arm, leg or the trunk, estimated the same way.
def.seg_pct: The segment's value compared with InBody's standard for your body, as the sheet prints it; 100 % = standard.
def.other_lean: Weight minus skeletal muscle and body fat: water, organs, bones and other non-fat tissue.
def.pct_of_weight: The value as a share of that day's body weight, computed for each measurement.

quote.2: A dumbbell a day keeps the fridge afraid.
quote.3: Muscles aren't built on the couch. But the planning there is superb.
quote.4: Today is a great day to start. So was yesterday, but that ship has sailed.
quote.5: The scale is just a number. A very grumpy number.
quote.6: Skip leg day and the stairs will remember.
quote.7: A schnitzel is no miracle; a workout sometimes is.
quote.8: Healthy lifestyle: a salad now and then and slightly fewer excuses than last time.
quote.9: The hardest rep is walking through the gym door.
quote.10: The numbers don't forgive, but at least they don't shout.
quote.11: Get measured. You can always blame the device later.
quote.12: Your biceps won't grow by themselves, but your laziness will.
quote.14: Nobody regrets a workout. Except the muscles, the next day.
quote.15: Best feeling after a workout: right after the shower. And lunch.
quote.16: Today's pain is tomorrow's muscle. Or at least a good excuse.
